requirement: Convert a domain formula into an evaluable expression: constants become constant expressions, variables resolve through the observation set, binary formulas evaluate with the stored operator, ternary formulas evaluate only the reachable branch, and a missing observation for a reachable operand produces a failure result.

preconditions.text: The formula tree is built in memory from constants, variables, and operators
Every variable the formula needs has an observation, unless a short-circuit spares it
A reachable variable of the formula has no observation
